newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - San Joaquin County, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the above Notes will be offered for public sale on at 9:00 A.M., California time (or on such other date as may be determined by the County Administrator of the County as provided in the paragraph below) at the office of Prager, McCarthy & Sealy (the Financial Advisor''), One Maritime Plaza, Suite 1000, San Francisco, California 94111

(telephone (415) 403-1905), and copies of the Official Notice of Sale (along with a Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Notes) will be furnished upon request to the Financial Advisor. Any sale date for the Notes may be changed at the sole discretion of the County Administrator of the County by providing notice thereof on the Munifacts News Service at least twenty-four (24) hours prior to the then scheduled sale date of the Notes. Dated:September 17, 1996
Clerk of the Board of Supervisors
of the County of San Joaquin
